responsibilities: Du wertest unsere Daten aus allen Projekten aus und machst daraus Reports und Dashboards, mit denen Geschäftsführung, Projektmanagement und Kunden wirklich arbeiten können.
Du richtest Datenbanken ein, pflegst sie und sorgst dafür, dass Daten aus Telefonie-, Ticket- und CRM-Systemen sauber zusammenlaufen.
Du liest Daten über Schnittstellen und Exporte aus, bereinigst sie und bringst sie in eine Struktur, auf die man sich verlassen kann.

Ein großer Teil deiner Arbeit ist Automatisierung. Du baust Workflows und automatisierte Prozesse, zum Beispiel mit n8n, Make oder eigenen Skripten, damit wiederkehrende Auswertungen, Datenabgleiche und Meldungen ohne Handarbeit laufen.
Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unseren Projektleitungen und unserer IT zusammen und bringst eigene Ideen ein, was sich noch einfacher und schneller lösen lässt.

Optimize and embed tracking algorithms on heterogeneous platforms with limited compute resources, ensuring real-time performance alongside other software bricks running on the drone.

responsibilities: Computer Vision Algorithm Development: Research and implement state-of-the-art Computer Vision approaches to Object Tracking in multiple modalities and scenarios, combining classical and geometrical methods with AI detection models developed in-house.
Multi-Sensor Fusion: Fuse data from multiple sensors (Cameras, IMU, Radar, etc.) to provide high-precision target estimation and robust tracking through challenging conditions.

Edge Optimization for Low-Compute Deployment: Optimize and embed tracking algorithms on heterogeneous platforms with limited compute resources, ensuring real-time performance alongside other software bricks running on the drone.
Cross-Team Collaboration: Work closely with the GNC, Sensor Fusion, and AI teams to integrate your tracking pipelines into a seamless, production-ready environment.
Research & Innovation: Stay at the absolute forefront of scientific trends in computer vision, tracking algorithms, and sensor fusion to introduce cutting-edge methodologies to the product.
Mentorship: Depending on seniority, support the team by managing or mentoring junior engineers.

responsibilities: You will develop and iterate on underwriting prediction models using a mix of approaches for tabular and sequential data
You will build and scale feature pipelines and training datasets from proprietary and third-party signals, partnering with data and platform teams when needed.
You will prototype new modeling ideas and features, run offline experiments, and drive the best-performing approaches into production with appropriate risk controls.
You will help productionize models: integrate into batch and/or real-time decision systems, and improve reliability, latency, and operational robustness.
You will instrument and monitor model and data health, and help define retraining/backtesting workflows

You will collaborate across Engineering, Risk Analytics, Product, and ML Platform to define requirements, evaluate tradeoffs, and communicate results clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
